## Summary
Owns data track packet header encoding and decoding, extension handling, and the participant SID extension used on data track packets. The package defines the wire layout helpers needed to marshal and unmarshal packet headers and payloads.

## Responsibilities
- Encode and decode data track packet headers and payloads.
- Track packet framing flags, sequence numbers, frame numbers, timestamps, and extension metadata.
- Add, replace, find, marshal, and unmarshal packet extensions.
- Represent the participant SID extension and validate its wire encoding.
